column7: Triage incoming customer-service requests (EN/DE) automatically, suggest a reply, and hand urgent cases to ServiceNow and Power Automate.

column1: As an agent I want each request classified into a category
column7:
Acceptance criteria:
- Categories: roadside, workshop, charging/EV, billing, complaint, general
- Works for English and German
- Response shows which keywords decided it (explainable)
- Unit tests for at least 10 example messages

column1: As an agent I want urgency detected so critical cases are handled first
column7:
Acceptance criteria:
- Levels: critical, high, normal, low
- Accident/smoke/brake failure => critical
- An LLM may never lower a 'critical' found by the rules
- Queue can be filtered by urgency

column1: As an agent I want a suggested reply in the customer's language
column7:
Acceptance criteria:
- Reply in DE or EN, with the ticket reference
- Critical replies mention the emergency number 112 first

column1: As an agent I want a web form and a queue view
column7:
Acceptance criteria:
- Form: name, e-mail, channel, message; validation errors shown
- Queue: urgency pill, category, status dropdown, ServiceNow number
- KPI tiles: total, critical, high, open

Acceptance criteria:
- POST /api/tickets, GET list with filters, GET/PATCH by reference
- POST /api/triage dry run
- Swagger at /docs

column1: Containerise the app with Docker and docker-compose (Postgres)
column7:
Acceptance criteria:
- Multi-stage image, non-root user, healthcheck
- docker compose up starts API + Postgres
- CI builds the image and runs a smoke test

Acceptance criteria:
- Deployment with liveness/readiness probes, resources, HPA
- Postgres StatefulSet with PVC
- Secrets not in git
- CI deploys to a kind cluster and checks /readyz

column1: Deploy to Azure Container Apps with GitHub Actions
column7:
Acceptance criteria:
- Public HTTPS URL
- Manual workflow builds in ACR and rolls out a new revision
- Scale to zero to save credit
- Steps documented in docs/azure.md

column1: Create ServiceNow incident for critical/high tickets
column7:
Acceptance criteria:
- Table API call with urgency/impact mapping
- Incident number stored and shown in the queue
- Failure never breaks ticket creation (logged only)

column1: Notify the team via Power Automate (Teams, Outlook, Excel)
column7:
Acceptance criteria:
- App calls the flow's HTTP trigger for critical/high
- Teams message for both, e-mail for critical only
- Excel row per escalation
- Flow documented with screenshots

Acceptance criteria:
- Data from /api/export.csv
- KPIs: tickets, open, escalation rate, German share
- Category x urgency chart, slicers for language/channel

column1: Optional: LLM triage via OpenAI / Azure OpenAI with rule fallback
column7:
Acceptance criteria:
- Used only when a key is set
- Invalid or failed LLM answer => rule engine result
- Tests with mocked API

column1: Write Confluence pages: architecture, runbook, decision log
column7:
Acceptance criteria:
- Architecture diagram
- Runbook: deploy, rollback, rotate secrets, common errors
- At least 3 decisions with reasons

column1: Spike: evaluate AI coding assistants for this project
column7: Try an AI coding assistant on two stories (e.g. tests, K8s manifests). Note time saved, mistakes it made, what needed human review. Write the findings to Confluence.
